candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Data Engineering in Dresden. You ask for Python, Git, Docker and data exploration with SQL, and these are the tools I used to build and ship my latest project.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. Before my Master's I designed data pipelines and data models in SAP data and analytics at TallyMarks Consulting.

achievements.impact: I built DocuMind, a RAG application with 37 offline unit tests, GitHub Actions CI and a Docker image
I designed and implemented SAP Datasphere data pipelines connecting the required sources
I used SQL analysis, validation and reconciliation to keep reporting accurate

letter.problems_section: I would help build and test data pipelines, explore data with SQL and Python and document my work. My Linux and shell scripting experience is basic, and I would build it up quickly on the job.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Dresden and can work up to 20 hours per week, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
